method: Timing model selection by grouped cross-validation within 80% training positions; hash-held-out 20% are never used for fitting or model selection. All contexts of a source position share their group. Target is next-stage time capped at 4000 ms; timeouts are right-censored, not exact times. Multiplicative errors exclude censored observations. Budget classification includes them because all exceed 1000 ms. No phone measurements.
